data.body: Debugging note on the small-fixture evidence at TMPDIR dbg-29290 (8 commits before, 4 after; ok=false, "verify-identity exited 1", reducer_equal=true). Observation: all 7 non-SNAPSHOT events in that fixture carry no author_sig. Experiment: enforced verify-identity --all (REQUIRE_AUTHENTICATED=1, no enforce_since) on a checked-out copy of the same fixture BEFORE any collapse also exits 1 with "0 verified, 7 unsigned". After the collapse the same 7 are unsigned (6 grandfathered below the re-anchored enforce_since, 1 enforced), and the anchor 370be7275c0 is an ancestor of HEAD. Conclusion: the exit 1 is the fixture's unsigned-by-design events, not a collapse defect. That evidence came from an intermediate harness revision that required exit 0; the merged harness (0433dec3663) compares before/after verdict counts instead, and its happy-path test asserts 7 unsigned on both sides.
